einzeiler: Danny McBride on creating goofy comedies and fragile blowhard characters.
kurzfassung: Actor and writer Danny McBride discusses his career behind comedies like The Righteous Gemstones and Eastbound and Down. He reflects on finding a community of filmmaker friends in North Carolina rather than Hollywood. He also talks about crafting characters unlike himself and his short story collection Thrilling Tales of Modern Men.
stichpunkte: Work on comedies like The Righteous Gemstones and Eastbound and Down
Finding a film community in North Carolina instead of Hollywood
Crafting characters that are very different from himself
Writing the short story collection Thrilling Tales of Modern Men
beschreibung:
The man behind artful and goofy comedies like The Righteous Gemstones and Eastbound and Down talks about finding his people at an upstart public film program in North Carolina, crafting characters that are nothing like himself, and nurturing a community of like-minded filmmaker friends far away from Hollywood.
He also discusses his new short story collection Thrilling Tales of Modern Men.
Podcast production by Cameron Drews.
